title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-020
doc_notes: This document is an archival report from the USAF/FAA regarding the JAL 1628 incident, containing detailed accounts of the encounter and subsequent FAA investigations.

encounters.summary: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 crew reported being shadowed for nearly an hour by two smaller objects and one massive globular craft over Alaska.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two smaller objects with amber and white lights; one massive globular craft with a lip around the middle, estimated size of two aircraft carriers.
encounters.entity_behavior: Maneuvered in tandem with the aircraft, hovered, and followed the flight path.
encounters.quote: The ships appeared to hover in front of the jumbo jet, then flew in level flight at the same speed
